Independent Patch Verification for Coding Agents with a Bidirectional Reconstruct-and-Verify Framework
description: Autonomous coding agents powered by large language models can now generate code patches directly from bug reports, but a fundamental gap remains: once a patch is produced, no mechanism independently verifies whether it truly resolves the reported problem. Prior work has sought to address this through iterative self-refinement and inference-time scaling, but these approaches either review the patch
authors: Chenglin Li, Yisen Xu, Zehao Wang
